meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文字、数据或标志做成几秒的动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让标题、数据或品牌标志动起来,做成一段短视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn text, data, or a logo into a short animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate headlines, stats, or a brand mark into a short clip

howto.what: Claude 会按你的主题做一支短片头/动效图：把文字、数字、图表、logo 或地图做成带运动的设计片段，通常不到 10 秒，没有旁白，输出 MP4 或透明叠层。
howto.when: 当你要一段 10 秒内的无旁白动效——文字动画、数字滚动、图表或 logo 等，或把网页、推文、新闻做成动画时触发；更长或带旁白的会转到 /general-video。

say.text: 帮我做一支 8 秒的 logo 收尾动效，最后停住。
say.note: 它先规划再合成，渲染前问你先预览还是直接渲染。

say.text: 把这份数据做成柱状图动画，数字从 0 涨上去。
say.note: 属于 charts/stat 类，纯代码，不找素材。

say.text: 把这个网页的滚动做成动效，带光标和标注。
say.note: 会先搜索网页素材，再按返回内容动画。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a short, design-led motion graphic from your topic — kinetic text, count-up numbers, charts, logo stings or map animations. Usually under 10s, no narration, output as MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a short, unnarrated, design-led motion piece — text, numbers, charts, logos, maps, or animation of a webpage, tweet or article. Longer or narrated work routes to /general-video.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second logo sting that holds on the final frame.
say_en.note: It plans, then composits; asks preview or render first.

say_en.text: Turn this data into a bar chart animation with counts rising from zero.
say_en.note: A charts/stat piece, no asset search needed.

say_en.text: Animate this webpage scroll with a cursor and callouts.
say_en.note: It searches web assets before animating.
